title: Department of Expenditure Gears Up for Swachhata
subtitle: Special Campaign 6.0 instructions have been issued to All Divisions and Admin Control Organisations
body_text:
The Department of Expenditure is fully prepared to implement the Special Campaign 6.0 for institutionalizing Swachhata and disposal of pending references. The campaign will be conducted in two well-structured phases i.e., Preparatory Phase from 15 th to 30 th September, 2026 and Implementation Phase from 2 nd to 31 st October, 2026.
All the Divisions of the Department along with organizations under the administrative control of this Department namely Controller General of Accounts, Chief Adviser Cost, Central Pension Accounting Office, Arun Jaitley National Institute of Financial Management have been sensitized to identify targets related to cleanliness, space management, scrap disposal, record management, pending references, etc. during the preparatory phase. This structured approach during the preparatory phase will ensure systematic and result-oriented action in the implementation phase of Special Campaign 6.0.
The Department of Expenditure along with its organizations had actively participated in Special Campaign 5.0 (2 nd to 31 st October, 2025), significantly contributing to the reduction of pendency and promoting a culture of cleanliness. The spirit and momentum of the campaign were sustained beyond the campaign period. During the period from December, 2025 to August, 2026, the Department made commendable progress in clearing pending matters, with the following outcomes: -
MP References:57
Comments given on Inter-Ministerial References (Cabinet Note): 339
State Government References: 1123
Public Grievances: 2788
Public Grievances Appeals: 141
The Department of Expenditure reaffirms its dedication to the successful execution of Special Campaign 6.0, aiming to further enhance administrative efficiency and cleanliness across all levels.
